stages.headline: Combinations of k out of n are k-element subsets (order does not matter); there are Cₙᵏ = n!/(k!(n − k)!) of them.
stages.headlineEnglish: Combinations of k out of n are k-element subsets (order does not matter); there are Cₙᵏ = n!/(k!(n − k)!) of them.

stages.headline: Properties: Cₙᵏ = Cₙⁿ⁻ᵏ, Cₙ⁰ = Cₙⁿ = 1, Cₙᵏ + Cₙᵏ⁺¹ = Cₙ₊₁ᵏ⁺¹.
